This is a selection from available material, not a claim that every relevant resource appears here.' The proposed change ('Start with a topic or question that matches your current work. This page lists selected materials related to the theme. Not every relevant resource is shown here; check other collections if you need further examples or more detail.') introduces: (1) instructional advice and practical orientation not stated in the source, (2) new language about 'check other collections' and seeking 'further examples or more detail,' which are not present or supported in the source text, and (3) alters the tone from neutral to directive. These additions go beyond clarification and introduce unsupported guidance.
